subject.title: fix(reply): suppress post-tool-send meta commentary as duplicate reply

question: Should maintainers make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97513 the canonical fix for the linked duplicate-reply issue, or repair this branch to cover the same reported compound acknowledgement cases and proof bar?
rationale: Two open same-root PRs target the same canonical issue; this branch is active but narrower and unproven, while the sibling is clean, proof-positive, and covers the compound examples that remain unsolved here.

options.title: Prefer the proof-positive sibling
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97513 as the canonical landing candidate and close or pause this PR after preserving any useful discussion.

options.title: Repair this branch
options.body: Keep this PR as the candidate only if it covers or explicitly narrows the compound acknowledgement cases and adds inspectable real behavior proof.

options.title: Accept standalone-only scope
options.body: Maintain this PR as a narrower mitigation only if the canonical issue or a follow-up remains open for compound acknowledgement duplicates.

recommendation.title: Prefer the proof-positive sibling
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97513 as the canonical landing candidate and close or pause this PR after preserving any useful discussion.
